name: itecs-halopsa
description: ITECS HaloPSA tools for technician operations, the sales opportunity workflow, Linux Codex CLI support and billing evidence.

interface.longDescription: 42 typed tools with visible additional agents, queues, workflows, native/custom change plans, metadata and current-agent resolution, notes, time, Start Work, email, tickets, projects and contracts, plus the sales opportunity workflow: Project Opportunities, prospect clients and contacts, internal document attachments and opportunity workflow stages. Includes optional client troubleshooting and confirmed-resolution closure workflows. Runs on Linux, macOS and Windows with the existing command-backed 1Password setup.
defaultPrompt: Work a ticket and identify the next useful diagnostic.
Assign this ticket to me and record the work I completed.
Create a low-priority ticket from my description.
Create a Project Opportunity for this new inquiry.
